content:
alyssa (sales): Hey team — PivotalBank just sent back the RFP and they want a short POC next week. Key asks: on‑prem/private deployment, HSM/KMS integration (FIPS 140-2), SLA for <50ms 95th percentile for short-text chat, and a pricing breakdown for committed capacity. Can we run through a quick checklist?

devin (solutions): Thanks. Primary blockers I see: 1) On‑prem package + HSM requires Private plan + our onprem installer (legal ok?). 2) Latency SLO might need Dedicated GPUs colocated to bank's AWS region or our private appliance. 3) Need a capability matrix mapping model variants + quantization + expected token cost.

samir (eng): For latency — if they target <50ms p95 for 32-token replies that's tight but possible with a 2xA10 pool and small context. Need to confirm request QPS and sequence length distribution. Also HSM integration: we support external KMS via KMIP and AWS CloudHSM; onprem HSM will need an HSM-side connector from their infra team.

maria-ops (solutions-engineer): I'll draft the POC plan. Proposed scope: 1) 3‑day smoke in our hosted staging for functional checks, 2) 5‑day Private deployment in customer VPC with KMS stub, 3) performance run (latency + tail) with synthetic and real prompt set, 4) final report + capability matrix and cost sheet. Deliverable: RFI appendix + runbook.

alyssa (sales): Timeline looks tight. Customer asked to start on Tue next week. Can we target Wed for handoff if we finalize scope today? Also they want an NDA before infra access.

devin (solutions): NDA is standard. Maria — can you list the infra vars we'll need from the bank (region, HSM vendor/model, allowed ports, expected peak RPS)? I'll add security questionnaire items.

maria-ops (solutions-engineer): Yep — will request: (a) HSM vendor & firmware, (b) VPC CIDR + peering requirements, (c) egress rules, (d) service account + KMS access policy template, (e) preferred model family. I'll attach a sample network diagram in the RFI.

samir (eng): For the capability matrix, I'll produce rows: model variant (redwood-7B/13B/70B), quantization (fp16/int8/int4), expected p95 latency (32/64 tokens), throughput (reqs/sec / per GPU), and cost $/token estimate for committed vs burst. Example snippet: ```redwood-13B | int8 | 35ms p95 | 120 req/s per A10 | $0.0009/token committed```

alyssa (sales): Nice. Pricing ask: they want committed monthly and a 'POC' transient price. Can someone draft a short pricing table we can give as an order-of-magnitude? Keep it conservative.

devin (solutions): For POC we typically do a time-limited trial with reduced rate. Proposed: POC rate = 50% of committed list for up to 2 weeks. Committed monthly: talk ranges — small: 4 GPUs, med: 16 GPUs, fd: 64 GPUs, with per-GPU monthly rates and a committed discount. I'll produce a short CSV.

maria-ops (solutions-engineer): Also add ops SLA for Private: we can offer 99.9% uptime on control plane + runbook response times; for onprem infra it's best-effort unless they buy Dedicated with managed nodes. Call this out in the RFI response.

alyssa (sales): Security questionnaire question: they asked about key custody — do we ever hold keys for Private deployments?

samir (eng): No — Private and onprem options use customer-managed KMS/HSM. We only store pointers and encrypted artifacts. For Hosted we offer Redwood-managed KMS (optional customer KMS). Will add exact language for the questionnaire: "Customer retains control of key material; Redwood stores encrypted references and never exports plaintext keys."

alyssa (sales): Perfect. Can someone drop an initial draft of the RFI appendix into the thread and I'll forward it to legal for NDA? Also need a one-page capability matrix for execs.

maria-ops (solutions-engineer): Uploading two drafts now: RFI_answers_v1.docx (attached) and capability_matrix_onepager.pdf (attached). Please review: focus on HSM flow diagram and latency caveats.

ops-bot: Note: A ticket has been created: #POC-5823 — assign to maria-ops, samir, devin. Deadline: 2024-11-08.

devin (solutions): Reviewing attachments. One ask: we need sample prompts from their compliance team to run QPS-limited tests (PII redaction, hallucination checks). Alyssa — can you request these in the handoff email?

alyssa (sales): On it. I'll request prompts + legal contact for NDA and HSM contact. Thanks everyone. Let's aim to finalize the capability matrix and pricing CSV by EOD PST. :thumbsup:
